title: When Does a Classifier Help an LLM? Classifier-Guided Prompting and Hybrid Classifier-LLM Models for Credit-Default Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.30086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Credit-default prediction is an important task in financial decision making. Traditional methods use fitted classifiers such as logistic regression and random forests on tabular features. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to this task through prompting. In this work we study how a fitted classifier and an LLM can be combined for credit-default prediction. We distinguish telling the LLM to imitate a classifier from using the classifier to build the prompt. We hypothesize that a fitted classifier can supply the ranking ability that an LLM prompt lacks. We experiment on the Default of Credit Card Clients dataset, and report recall, F1, and the area under the ROC and precision-recall curves, with bootstrap confidence intervals. translated_title: 分类器何时能帮助大语言模型？用于信贷违约预测的分类器引导提示与分类器-LLM混合模型
translated_abstract: 信贷违约预测是金融决策中的一项重要任务。传统方法在表格特征上使用拟合好的分类器，如逻辑回归和随机森林。大语言模型（LLM）最近通过提示工程被应用于这一任务。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何将拟合的分类器与LLM相结合用于信贷违约预测。我们区分了“让LLM模仿分类器”与“使用分类器来构建提示”这两种方式。我们假设拟合好的分类器能够提供LLM提示所缺乏的排序能力。我们在信用卡客户违约数据集上进行实验，报告了召回率、F1分数、ROC曲线下面积和精确率-召回率曲线下面积，并使用自助法置信区间。我们观察到，少样本LLM在所有单一模型中具有最高的召回率（0.47）和F1分数（0.50），但其排序能力不如随机森林（AUC-ROC为0.72，而随机森林为0.79）。指示LLM模仿分类器……
tldr: 该研究探讨了分类器与大语言模型在信贷违约预测中的结合方式，发现少样本LLM召回率最高但排序能力不及随机森林，并提出通过分类器引导提示或构建混合模型来弥补LLM排序能力的不足。
en_tdlr: This study investigates combining fitted classifiers with LLMs for credit-default prediction, finding that a few-shot LLM achieves the highest recall but ranks worse than a random forest, and proposes classifier-guided prompting and hybrid classifier-LLM models to compensate for the LLM's lack of ranking ability.
